A group of participants stands extremely close to the camera wearer—mostly within arm’s reach—in a tight inward-facing circle. Their arms and hands extend toward the center, creating a team-huddle gesture directly in front of the wearer. The surrounding path is crowded, while the climbing wall is several meters behind them; nobody is visibly climbing or displaying technique to assess. The wearer should support the group interaction, then circulate and offer help and encouragement as activities begin.
